livingpaths.configuration.title: Living Paths Configuration
config.livingpaths.section.wear_threshol: Traffic required for each path-development stage.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.grass: Crossings required for Grass Block to become a Dirt Path or biome-specific alternative.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.mud.t: Crossings required for Mud to become Packed Mud.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.packe: Crossings required for Packed Mud to become its biome-specific compacted path material.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.podzo: Crossings required for Podzol to become a Dirt Path.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.mycel: Crossings required for Mycelium to become a Dirt Path.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.dirt_: Crossings required for a Dirt Path to become its biome-specific established path material.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.moss_: Crossings required for a Moss Block to become Rooted Dirt.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.roote: Crossings required for Rooted Dirt to become Coarse Dirt.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.coars: Crossings required for Coarse Dirt to become Gravel.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.grave: Crossings required for Gravel to become Cobblestone or Mossy Cobblestone.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.cobbl: Crossings required for established Cobblestone created by Living Paths to become Stone.
config.livingpaths.wear_thresholds.stone: Crossings required for Stone originating from a Living Paths path to become Smooth Stone.
config.livingpaths.section.wear_decay.to: Gradual reduction of stored wear at inactive positions.
config.livingpaths.wear_decay.enabled.to: Allow unused stored wear to decrease over time.
config.livingpaths.wear_decay.interval_d: Inactive Minecraft days between wear-decay steps.
config.livingpaths.wear_decay.amount.too: Wear points removed during each decay step.
config.livingpaths.section.protected_blo: Blocks that Living Paths must not wear or replace.
config.livingpaths.protected_blocks.bloc: Namespaced block IDs to protect; Farmland is included by default.
config.livingpaths.section.entity_traffi: Traffic settings and wear weights for non-player entities.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.enable: Master switch for all non-player entity traffic.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.vanill: Allow selected ground-based vanilla non-animal mobs to create wear.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.animal: Allow vanilla animals to create wear; this may create paths in enclosures.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.mineco: Allow MineColonies Citizens to create wear when MineColonies is installed.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.player: Allow Nox to create wear when Player Two is installed.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.normal: Wear points contributed by a normal vanilla mob crossing.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.heavy_: Wear points contributed by an Iron Golem, Ravager or Warden crossing.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.animal: Wear points contributed by an animal crossing when animal traffic is enabled.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.citize: Wear points contributed by a MineColonies Citizen crossing.
config.livingpaths.entity_traffic.player: Wear points contributed by a Player Two companion crossing.

config.livingpaths.regeneration.interval: Inactive Minecraft days between individual regeneration stages.
